review.purpose: Retain message-kind context without treating a recognized root as validity.
review.finding: Six of eight inputs are Response, including changed/wrapped/unsigned messages. Malformed input is unknown while absent input is NULL. Root classification and base64 normalization do not distinguish signature evidence.

review.purpose: Separate parsing from cryptographic and missing-input evidence.
review.finding: Six recognized messages parse; malformed input fails even with an empty anomaly list, while missing input retains NULL. Matrix preserves unavailable/inapplicable versus false checks; root kind does not override parse failure.

review.purpose: Expose the first decoded subject/assertion without assuming every claim or signature belongs to it.
review.finding: The wrapping fixture has two assertions and its first decoded assertion differs from the signature reference. Record-scoped joins preserve that distinction; flattened claims are not automatically assigned to the decoded first subject.

review.purpose: Separate signature mathematics, canonicalization and referenced-content digest from external signer context.
review.finding: Five inputs pass signature mathematics. Changed subject still fails content digest; embedded-certificate math is not trust. Adding the EC certificate changes inventory membership/category only and does not repair cryptographic or structural failures.

review.purpose: Retain structural findings and avoid interpreting an empty list as validity.
review.finding: Changed fixture reports digest-mismatch and wrapping fixture reports multiple-assertions. Unsigned/malformed examples can have empty lists and still fail separate evidence. Ordered review categories retain all eight inputs.

review.purpose: Enumerate assertion identity/parent before joining signature references within each input.
review.finding: Wrapping fixture emits two assertions; only one directly joins its signature reference. Composite record/assertion key prevents repeated fixture IDs across files from cross-matching; scope caveats remain explicit.

review.purpose: Inspect signature scope/reference IDs and cryptographic fields beside assertion rows.
review.finding: The signed reference targets a different assertion from the wrapping fixture first decode. Math and digest still pass for that referenced assertion; this is a narrow diagnostic, not a general response-signature or transform coverage algorithm.

review.purpose: Show how flattening and deduplicating claims can conceal source multiplicity.
review.finding: Wrapped message has six attribute-value rows across two statements versus three across one for RSA; role rows double two→four but both yield two distinct role values. statement_idx is not an assertion/signature key, and claimed values do not authorize the decoded subject.
